# Design Spec — Dashboard Showcase + Layout Kit in `@mfe/ui`

**Date:** 2026-09-14  
**Status:** draft (brainstorm) — historical; execution plan owns status  
**Approach:** Approach 1 — Layered `@mfe/ui` (theme + layout + widgets) + shell rewrite + demo Home/Dashboard (~16–22h)  
**Package:** `packages/mfe-ui/` (extends theme-only package from prior spec)  
**Plan (do not edit this file for status):** [`plans/260915-0001-dashboard-layout-widgets/plan.md`](../../plans/260915-0001-dashboard-layout-widgets/plan.md)  
**Reference:** `vite-micro-frontends/host-dashboard` (rewrite MUI 6; no Tailwind dump)  
**Predecessor:** Shared theme ([spec](./2026-09-14-shared-theme-mfe-ui-spec.md), plan completed); Cross-remote state; Admin D5

Where this spec conflicts with the shared-theme spec’s “React-free / theme only / no chart Dashboard”: **this spec supersedes those non-goals** for layout kit + presentational widgets + demo Home/Dashboard. Theme/mode sync rules and Guarantee #8 remain. Feedback components (Loader/Empty/Result/Confirm) stay **per-app**, not in `@mfe/ui`.

---

## 1. Problem statement

Authenticated shell chrome is functional but plain (basic AppBar + drawer). Demo Home/Status are thin showcases. Reference `host-dashboard` has polished admin layout (header/drawer/widths) and rich Home + Dashboard widget grids (MUI + recharts, fixture data).

Roadmap already ported **theme tokens** into `@mfe/ui`. Next gap: reusable **layout primitives** and **dashboard widgets**, composed so demo + admin inherit one beautiful shell without nested sidebars or copying Tailwind.

### User stories

- As a signed-in user, `/app/*` shows polished header, sidebar, and footer; demo and admin share that chrome.
- As a DASHBOARD-scoped user, `/app/demo` shows a Home widget grid and `/app/demo/dashboard` an analytics widget grid (fixture data), themed via `@mfe/ui`.
- As a developer, I import layout + widgets from `@mfe/ui` (`file:`); pages pass English string/data props; no i18n or fetch inside the package.
- As the platform, nav remains **accessible-driven** (not hardcoded reference menu); mount contract unchanged.

### Non-goals

- Feedback components inside `@mfe/ui` (Loader, Empty, Result, ConfirmDialog — per-app only)
- Profile / FAQ / Help / UserManagement pages from reference
- SettingsDrawer / layout-density persistence
- Backend metrics APIs / React Query dashboard hooks
- i18next in `@mfe/ui` or platform-wide i18n
- Nested remote sidebar / double chrome
- Landing adoption of layout/widgets
- `@mfe/ui` in Module Federation `shared`
- `themeMode` on `RemoteMountContext`
- Vue remotes, visual snapshot / pixel parity with reference
- Replacing admin CRUD UI this phase (admin only inherits shell chrome)

## 4. Architecture & components

### Units

| Unit | Owns | Must not |
|------|------|----------|
| `packages/mfe-ui` | theme/mode; layout primitives; dashboard/home widgets; assets used by those widgets | fetch, axios, router, i18n, auth, feedback comps |
| `shell` | Compose layout kit; accessibles → nav; logout; theme toggle; snackbar/`onNotify` | Import `widgets/*` (avoid recharts); hardcode reference menu |
| `demo-react` | Home + Dashboard grids; `fixtures/*`; local feedback if needed; optional Status keep | Second sidebar; put fixtures inside `@mfe/ui` |
| `admin-react` | Inherit shell chrome; existing CRUD | Nested drawer; must not block on widgets |
| `landing` | Unchanged | Import layout/widgets this phase |

### Package layout (target)

```
packages/mfe-ui/
  package.json          # peers: react, react-dom, @mui/material, @mui/icons-material;
                        # optional peer: recharts (required if importing widgets)
  src/
    index.ts            # theme, mode, layout exports
    mode.ts
    theme/
    layout/             # AppHeader, NavDrawer, AppFooter, PageToolbar, widths
    widgets/            # Home + Dashboard presentational cards
    assets/             # SVGs needed by widgets (e.g. welcome) — not generic empty/error set
  exports:
    "."           → theme + mode + layout
    "./widgets"   → chart/card widgets (pulls recharts)
```

If package-exports subpath proves painful in Vite/`file:` setup, single entry is allowed **only if** shell imports stay layout/theme-only (lint/review discipline).

### Hard rules

1. Presentational only in `@mfe/ui` — props/children; no `api`, react-query, i18n, react-router hard dependency (router via `component`/`href` slots or children).
2. No second sidebar in remotes.
3. Rewrite reference UI against platform theme tokens — no Tailwind/file dump.
4. Nav from `accessibles` only.
5. Feedback stays custom per app.

### Runtime composition

```
Gate → ShellLayout
         ├─ AppHeader / NavDrawer / AppFooter   ← @mfe/ui layout
         └─ Outlet → RemoteOutlet → demo mount
                         ├─ /           HomePage    ← fixtures → widgets
                         └─ /dashboard  DashboardPage
```

Admin mounts under the same shell chrome with zero nested nav drawer.

---

## 5. Data flow & interfaces

### Shell → layout kit

- `navItems`: `{ key, label, href, icon?, selected }[]` from `accessibles` (`title`, `routeName` → `/app/:routeName`).
- Header actions: theme toggle, logout (and existing gear only if already present — no SettingsDrawer panel this phase).
- Footer: product name + short line via props/children.
- Drawer: mobile overlay + optional collapse widths (`drawerWidth` 280, `drawerCollapsedWidth` 104 from reference) if low-cost; collapse state owned by shell.

### Demo → widgets

- `fixtures/home.ts`, `fixtures/dashboard.ts`: static English labels + series arrays ported from reference widgets.
- Pages map fixtures → widget props.
- Future: replace fixtures with `api.*` in the **page**; widget contracts unchanged.

### Illustrative widget props

| Widget | Props (concept) |
|--------|-----------------|
| `OverviewWidget` | `title`, `description` |
| `ActivityWidget` | `title`, `series` |
| `BudgetWidget` / sales/circle charts | chart data arrays + titles |
| `ProgressWidget` | `title`, `value`, `avatar?` |
| `WelcomeWidget` | titles/body + asset |
| Social/home cards | labels, counts, optional avatar URLs from fixtures |

Colors: widgets read MUI `useTheme()`; no hardcoded reference palette bypassing `@mfe/ui` theme.

### Peers

| Peer | Required by |
|------|-------------|
| `react`, `react-dom` | layout + widgets |
| `@mui/material`, `@mui/icons-material` | layout + widgets |
| `recharts` | `@mfe/ui/widgets` consumers (demo) |

Docker/bind-mount: demo image installs recharts; shell does not need recharts if it never imports widgets.

---

## 6. Error handling & edge cases

- No HTTP inside `@mfe/ui` — no package-level API errors.
- Empty `series` → empty chart container, no throw.
- Progress values clamped 0–100 where applicable.
- Missing `recharts` → build/import failure for widget importers (documented peer).
- Empty `accessibles` → existing shell empty main; chrome still renders.
- Logout / remote load failures → existing shell behavior.
- Mode helper failure → light default (unchanged).

---

## 7. Testing strategy

| Layer | What |
|-------|------|
| Unit `@mfe/ui` | Existing theme/mode tests; NavDrawer/AppFooter smoke; 1–2 widget smokes (incl. empty series) |
| Typecheck/build | shell, demo-react, admin-react green; demo has recharts |
| E2E (Puppeteer) | Login dashboard user → Home widget text; open `/app/demo/dashboard` → overview/activity text; shell drawer still lists remotes; theme toggle still works |
| Regression | `/app/admin` list still loads under new chrome |
| Manual | Mobile drawer; footer visible; no double sidebar |
| Out | Pixel snapshots, a11y CI, chart load tests |

---

## 8. Implementation considerations & risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Package grows heavy; shell pulls recharts | Subpath `@mfe/ui/widgets` or strict import ban in shell |
| Conflicts with completed theme plan “theme only” | This spec explicitly supersedes that non-goal; keep mode/theme APIs stable |
| Demo Home already exists (profile/`api`) | Replace/extend page into widget grid; keep Status optional |
| Widget count (~15) inflates timeline | Port in batches: layout kit first, then Home widgets, then Dashboard charts |
| Reference uses i18n keys everywhere | Strip to English props at port time |
| Collapse drawer complexity | Ship fixed width first; add collapse if time remains |

### Suggested build order (for later `/plan`)

1. Package peers + export paths; layout primitives + widths  
2. Shell rewrite onto layout kit + footer  
3. Copy/adapt widget assets; Home widgets + demo Home + fixtures  
4. Dashboard widgets + `/dashboard` route  
5. Tests + docs (code-standards-frontend, codebase-summary, CLAUDE package blurb)

---

## 9. Success metrics & validation

- Shell shows upgraded header/sidebar/footer; demo and admin share it; **one** sidebar only.
- `/app/demo` and `/app/demo/dashboard` render fixture-driven widget grids using `@mfe/ui` widgets.
- `@mfe/ui` contains **no** Loader/Empty/Result/Confirm exports.
- No new mount-context fields; no tokens in `localStorage` beyond existing theme mode key.
- Unit + typecheck/build + e2e smoke pass as in §7.
- Docs updated to describe layout/widgets ownership (theme plan’s “React-free package” language revised).
